title: Senior React Native Developer
description: We are looking for a Senior React Native Developer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of our high-performance mobile applications.
experience: 5+ years of software development (3+ years dedicated to React Native)
responsibilities: 1.Develop Applications: Build robust clean and highly responsive mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native.
Architect Code: Design scalable mobile architectures and write reusable maintainable code components.
Optimize Performance: Troubleshoot profile and optimize application performance animations and load times.
Bridge Native Code: Write and integrate custom Native Modules in Swift/Objective-C or Java/Kotlin when required.
Lead & Mentor: Review team code mentor junior developers and establish engineering best practices.
Collaborate: Partner closely with UI/UX designers product managers and backend engineers to ship new features.
qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Technical Expertise: Proven track record of shipping successful apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
State Management: Deep understanding of state management libraries like Redux MobX or React Context API.
API Integration: Strong experience consuming RESTful APIs GraphQL and handling offline data storage.
Testing: Proficiency in writing unit integration and component tests using tools like Jest and Detox.
CI/CD Pipelines: Experience setting up mobile deployment pipelines using Fastlane Bitrise or GitHub Actions

title: Junior React Native Developer
description: We are looking for a motivated Junior React Native Developer to join our mobile engineering team and help build cross-platform applications for iOS and Android.
responsibilities: Feature Development: Write clean maintainable JavaScript/TypeScript code to implement mobile app features.
UI Implementation: Translate UI/UX design wireprints into functional responsive mobile screens.
Bug Fixing: Debug issues fix crashes and optimize code to improve app stability.
API Integration: Connect mobile frontends with RESTful backend APIs and third-party services.
Team Collaboration: Participate in code reviews daily standups and learn from senior developers.
qualifications: Education: Degree in Computer Science Bootcamp graduate or equivalent practical experience.
Technical Skills: Solid understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) React and fundamental mobile concepts.
State Management: Basic knowledge of React Context API Redux or similar state solutions.
Tools: Experience using Git for version control and familiarity with npm/yarn.
Soft Skills: Eagerness to learn strong problem-solving skills and good communication.
